name: web-fashion-store-flow-overview-board-on-navy
title: Board of nine fashion-store screens: product page, search, everyday grid, listing, offer, success modal, cart, orders map and mega menu
whatItIs: A dark navy board with nine white desktop screens for one store: a product detail with thumbnails, a search overlay, an 'Off-white everyday' colour-tinted photo mosaic, a men's hoodies listing with filters, an offers hero, a payment success modal, a cart with express buttons, an order tracking map and a mega menu with featured photos.
whatItMeans: Thorough and tidy; showing every state together proves a full system.
techniques: Tile screens in a grid on a dark board.
Tint model photos in different pastel backgrounds.
Keep the UI black and white.

vocabulary.definition: A board showing many screens of one flow.
A collage of photos on different pastel backdrops.
A wide dropdown with many links and images.
A tracking map beside an order timeline.
